name: skill-foundry
description: A Markdown-first Codex plugin for extracting experience, forging reusable Agent Skills, and evolving them from real feedback.

interface.shortDescription: Build and refine reusable Agent Skills.
interface.longDescription: Three built-in Skills that form a deliberate lifecycle: reverse-engineer experience, decide whether it belongs in a reusable Skill, and evolve that Skill only after real usage and explicit confirmation.
